info.name: HealNSight Telehealth Bangladesh — Complete 58 APIs Collection
info.description: Complete collection of all 58 APIs across Django Backend (:8000), Node.js Auth Microservice (:5000), and FastAPI Worker (:6000). Includes headers, sample JSON payloads, parameters, and authentication tokens.

item.name: 1. Django Authentication & Security
item.description: User registration, SimpleJWT tokens, TOTP Multi-Factor Authentication, and password reset.

request.description: Registers a new patient, doctor, or admin account.
Authenticates credentials and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Initiates MFA-enforced login. Returns session_token if MFA is enabled.
Verifies the 6-digit TOTP code and issues JWT tokens upon success.
Obtains a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Requests a password reset token from Django backend.
Resets account password using Django token.

item.name: 2. User Profiles & Doctor KYC
item.description: User profile management and admin doctor credential verification.

request.description: Fetches full demographic, patient, or doctor profile details.
Updates demographic and role-specific profile fields (patient/doctor).
Returns directory of approved doctors with specialty, hospital, and fees.
Admin endpoint listing doctors pending verification review.

item.name: 2.5 Admin - Approve or Reject Doctor KYC

request.description: Approves or rejects doctor registration credentials.

item.name: 3. Appointments & Clinical Consultations
item.description: Telemedicine appointment scheduling, modification, and consultation session management.

request.description: Lists upcoming appointments for current user.
Schedules a new appointment with a doctor.
Reschedules, confirms, or updates appointment status.
Cancels the scheduled appointment.
Retrieves clinical session notes, vitals, and diagnosis for a consultation.
Doctor records clinical findings, vitals, and diagnosis during or after call.

item.name: 4. E2EE Medical Records & Patient Consent
item.description: Encrypted health record storage and patient consent management for doctor access.

request.description: Lists patient's medical records and test reports.
Stores patient health record with end-to-end encryption metadata.
Lists all doctors who currently hold access consent to patient records.
Explicitly authorizes a doctor to view patient medical history.
Revokes a doctor's access to patient records immediately.

item.name: 5. Digital E-Prescriptions & Pharmacy Sharing
item.description: Issue digital prescriptions and create cryptographic time-limited share links for pharmacies.

request.description: Lists all issued or received digital prescriptions.
Doctor generates an authenticated digital prescription.
Generates a secure cryptographic share token for pharmacy dispensing.
Public verification endpoint allowing pharmacies to view verified prescription.

item.name: 6. Pharmacy Catalog & Medicine Orders
item.description: Search available pharmaceuticals and manage home delivery orders.

request.description: Search medicine inventory with dosage, manufacturer, and pricing.
Lists user's medicine orders and delivery status.
Submits medicine order for pharmacy packaging and home delivery.
Updates delivery progress (processing, dispatched, delivered).

item.name: 7. Payment Gateway (SSLCommerz V4)
item.description: Payment session initiation, callback handlers, IPN webhooks, status queries, and billing history.

request.description: Generates SSLCommerz payment gateway session URL (supports bKash, Nagad, cards).
Browser return callback upon customer completion at payment gateway.
Server-to-server instant payment notification handler from SSLCommerz.
Real-time check on payment settlement status.
Retrieves patient's past transaction history and invoices.

item.name: 8. Telephony & Cellular Voice Consultations
item.description: Cellular bridge for rural patients without stable internet connectivity via Twilio PSTN.

request.description: Bridges doctor and patient on a live cellular telephone call.
Hangs up active telephone bridge call.
Queries live call state (queued, ringing, in-progress, completed).
Lists voice call records and duration for a consultation.
Serves dynamic TwiML XML instructions to Twilio telephony server.
Generates consultation audio conference room TwiML XML.

item.name: 9. Government Healthcare Registry Verification
item.description: Integration with Bangladesh Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), NID, and BMDC.

request.description: Verifies 10/13/17 digit Bangladeshi National ID against DGHS/Election Commission records.
Validates Bangladesh Medical & Dental Council medical practitioner registration.

item.name: 10. Encrypted File Storage
item.description: Upload and download encrypted diagnostic imaging and clinical documents.

request.description: Uploads encrypted binary or base64 file to secure medical storage.
Downloads or streams encrypted file for authorized clinical inspection.

item.name: 11. Blockchain & Cryptographic Audit Ledger
item.description: Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chain ledger with Ethereum smart contract notarization.

request.description: Lists immutable blockchain audit blocks with SHA-256 current and previous hashes.
Recomputes SHA-256 block hash and validates link against preceding block.
Inspects on-chain Ethereum / Sepolia transaction receipt and block timestamp.

item.name: 12. Audit Logs & Diagnostic Image Profiles
item.description: System access audit trail and multi-modal image profile storage.

request.description: Admin endpoint querying security, profile, and clinical action audit trails.
Lists patient diagnostic scans (ECG, CBC) and digitized summaries.
Creates diagnostic scan record with pre-extracted clinical summary.

item.name: 13. AI Health Assistant & Symptom Triage
item.description: Bilingual Bengali/English clinical triage with OpenAI and local deterministic fallback.

request.description: Evaluates symptoms in Bengali or English and provides triage urgency (EMERGENCY, URGENT, ROUTINE).
Lists previous symptom assessment conversations.
Retrieves dialogue messages and clinical recommendations for a conversation session.

item.name: 14. Django Channels Real-Time WebSockets
item.description: Real-time consultation signaling and in-call messaging.

request.description: WebSocket endpoint handling WebRTC SDP offer/answer exchanges, ICE candidate negotiation, and live room text chat.

item.name: 15. Node.js Authentication & OTP Microservice
item.description: Dedicated microservice on Port 5000 managing rate-limited OTP challenges and password reset.

request.description: Returns microservice health status and service identity.
Registers user directly in shared database with Django PBKDF2 hash.
Authenticates credentials and returns JWT bearer token.
Generates 6-digit cryptographic OTP, logs challenge, and dispatches via SMS/email (Rate-limited).
Validates submitted OTP code against active 10-minute challenge window.
Applies new password, hashes with pbkdf2_sha256 matching Django format, and invalidates OTP.
Queries OTP challenge , IP addresses, and verification statuses.

item.name: 16. FastAPI AI & Multimodal Worker
item.description: High-throughput asynchronous service on Port 6000 for multimodal ECG/CBC extraction and Speech-to-Text streaming.

request.description: Checks FastAPI worker uptime and connectivity.
Simulates multimodal LLaVA/GPT-4o vision extraction of ECG rhythm or CBC blood count values, committing findings directly to database.
Accepts 100ms binary PCM audio packets from browser microphone and streams back clinical dialogue transcription segments.
